blocks.text: Product photo pipeline notes, December 14

This is the working cut for HBR-MTG-2021-081 on December 14, 2021. Jenna Park asked for a written bound after the current path (840 photos on photos.harbor.internal, mixed HEIC and JPEG) stopped being honest. I am Michael Gilfilian, Web Developer, writing for Dana Whitlock, Jenna Park, and Nia Brooks. Primary host photos.harbor.internal. If you are skimming, jump the decision callout, then the refuse on uncompressed lifestyle gallery on every PDP, then open questions. If you are implementing next week, jump the constraints, the numbers table, and the commands or contracts.

Max 2400px on the long edge, WebP plus JPEG fallback, alt text is product plus color. No lifestyle gallery on PDP until LCP holds. I am not restating a hallway yes. uncompressed lifestyle gallery on every PDP is out because Jenna's capture: LCP 3.81s on LTE. Dana's sister-in-law photos are not a reason to blow the budget. Cost of doing nothing is already in the numbers: look at photos=840, lcp=3.81, maxpx=2400, mb=4.0, weeks=3, skus=412, fallback=1, cdn=1.2. Sibling tickets HBR-2604 and HBR-2604-CDN. I will not reopen uncompressed lifestyle gallery on every PDP in a side thread because a vendor sent a discount. Jenna Park is the acceptor unless the owners line says otherwise.
Decision for leadership

blocks.text: Max 2400px on the long edge, WebP plus JPEG fallback, alt text is product plus color. No lifestyle gallery on PDP until LCP holds.

Background on photos.harbor.internal. 840 photos on photos.harbor.internal, mixed HEIC and JPEG. That is the system Dana Whitlock lives with, not a slide. I timed or pulled the leftover on cdn-preview.harbor.internal the week before this file. Lag, stale minutes, or miss counts in this file are from that pull, not a round number I liked. Ticket HBR-MTG-2021-081 names the pull. If those numbers moved after December 14, 2021, update this file in review, do not 'correct' them in Slack.

blocks.text: Background. Why the current path is the wrong tool

Nia Brooks owns a leftover that is easy to skip: shop.harbor.internal. I will ping once. After that the owner is late, not blocked. Unique to this file (17): refuse on uncompressed lifestyle gallery on every PDP, lock is 2400px, WebP, alt pattern, lifestyle off PDP. I will not hide a product change inside a 'quick align' on HBR-2604.
A 4MB hero is not 'more professional.' It is a 3.8 second LCP on a phone in the parking lot.

What a skeptical user would try first on photos.harbor.internal: the path Jenna Park actually has, not a desktop demo. Metric I will argue is time-to-useful, not a vanity QPS. If we cannot show that path on cdn-preview.harbor.internal with the numbers already in this file, we do not have a cut. Michael Gilfilian will not accept a laptop screenshot as that proof.
Constraints and the lock

blocks.text: 2400px, WebP, alt pattern, lifestyle off PDP Host photos.harbor.internal. Ticket HBR-2604. Acceptor Dana Whitlock.

What I will not claim in HBR-MTG-2021-081

I will not claim uncompressed lifestyle gallery on every PDP is impossible for a competitor. I will claim we will not buy it. I will not claim zero incidents after this cut. I will claim the next one dies at the gate named in the lock. Host photos.harbor.internal.

First useful is 2400px, WebP, alt pattern, lifestyle off PDP, not a prettier theme or a bigger box. Jenna Park sees that slice on photos.harbor.internal. If the slice needs a second product, that is a new ticket and Dana Whitlock is in the thread. I will not hide it inside HBR-MTG-2021-081.
